evidence.purpose: Measure revenue for Japan, Q2 1995 vs Q2 1996
evidence.sql:
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN o.o_orderdate >= '1995-04-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1995-07-01' THEN l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount) ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_a,
  SUM(CASE WHEN o.o_orderdate >= '1996-04-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1996-07-01' THEN l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount) ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_b,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.o_orderdate >= '1995-04-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1995-07-01' THEN o.o_orderkey END) AS orders_a,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.o_orderdate >= '1996-04-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1996-07-01' THEN o.o_orderkey END) AS orders_b,
  SUM(CASE WHEN o.o_orderdate >= '1995-04-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1995-07-01' THEN l.l_quantity ELSE 0 END) AS units_a,
  SUM(CASE WHEN o.o_orderdate >= '1996-04-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1996-07-01' THEN l.l_quantity ELSE 0 END) AS units_b
FROM causa_erp.lineitem l
  JOIN causa_erp.orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
  JOIN causa_erp.customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
  JOIN causa_erp.nation cn ON c.c_nationkey = cn.n_nationkey
WHERE ((o.o_orderdate >= '1995-04-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1995-07-01') OR (o.o_orderdate >= '1996-04-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1996-07-01'))
  AND cn.n_name = 'JAPAN'

Segment mix (AUTOMOBILE, BUILDING, FURNITURE, HOUSEHOLD, MACHINERY) may have changed between Q2 1995 and Q2 1996.

draft.summary: Japan's revenue fell from $19.17M [Q1] to $16.08M [Q1] in Q2 1996 vs Q2 1995, a 16.1% [Q1] decline driven primarily by a volume drop of -$3.33M [Q1] partially offset by a modest price increase of $242.4K [Q1]; the decline outpaced the company‑wide -3.5% [Q2] by roughly the gap between -16.1% [Q1] and -3.5% [Q2].

claims.text: Units fell from 18,387 [Q1] to 15,191 [Q1]; revenue per unit rose from $1042.62 [Q1] to $1058.58 [Q1]; volume effect -$3.33M [Q1] and price effect +$242.4K [Q1] pulled in opposite directions, making the change mainly volume-driven.
Company‑wide revenue fell -3.5% [Q2] (-$11.16M [Q2]), so Japan underperformed the company by roughly the gap between -16.1% [Q1] and -3.5% [Q2].

Individual customer Customer#000000764 [Q8] fell from $1.11M [Q8] to $130.9K [Q8], a change of -$977.6K [Q8] representing 32% [Q8] of the total change and 3.9 standard deviations [Q8] from the overall trend, making it the single largest driver.

By customer market segment [Q4], AUTOMOBILE fell -$2.29M [Q4] (74% [Q4], z=-2.0 [Q4]), HOUSEHOLD fell -$1.60M [Q4] (52% [Q4], z=-2.5 [Q4]), MACHINERY fell -$1.05M [Q4] (34% [Q4], z=-1.0 [Q4]), while BUILDING rose $1.00M [Q4] (-32% [Q4], z=3.2 [Q4]) and FURNITURE rose $844.8K [Q4] (-27% [Q4], z=2.7 [Q4]); segment contributions were sizeable but none alone accounted for the full Japan decline.

By order priority [Q5], 2-HIGH fell -$2.12M [Q5] (69% [Q5], z=-2.7 [Q5]), 5-LOW rose $699.3K [Q5] (-23% [Q5], z=2.4 [Q5]), 3-MEDIUM fell -$694.8K [Q5] (22% [Q5], z=-0.3 [Q5]), 1-URGENT fell -$580.0K [Q5] (19% [Q5], z=0.1 [Q5]), and 4-NOT SPECIFIED fell -$396.3K [Q5] (13% [Q5], z=0.4 [Q5]); the 2-HIGH category was the largest contributor but its significance was moderate.

Customer region [Q3] shows Asia accounted for 100% [Q3] of the total change but with z=0.0 [Q3], indicating no significant divergence from the overall trend; thus region does not explain the Japan change.

Return status [Q9] shows N (non‑returned) fell -$2.64M [Q9] (85% [Q9], z=0.2 [Q9]) and R (returned) fell -$449.6K [Q9] (15% [Q9], z=-0.8 [Q9]); neither moved significantly relative to the overall trend.

CRM [Q7] recorded 11 events [Q7] around the period, including 8 complaint events [Q7] from 1995‑04‑02 through 1995‑08‑24 all concerning late delivery or invoice disputes, and 2 renewal events [Q7] on unchanged terms; the data documents routine issues but does not establish a causal mechanism for the revenue change.

Part manufacturer [Q10] changes were small; Manufacturer#3 rose $159.1K [Q10] (-5% [Q10], z=1.5 [Q10]) and other manufacturers had negative changes with z‑scores below 2, so manufacturer composition does not explain the Japan revenue shift.

report.markdown:
Japan revenue fell $3.09M [Q1] from $19.17M [Q1] to $16.08M [Q1] (-16.1% [Q1]) in Q2 1996 vs Q2 1995. The decline was volume-driven: units dropped from 18,387 [Q1] to 15,191 [Q1] (volume effect -$3.33M [Q1]) while revenue per unit rose from $1,042.62 [Q1] to $1,058.58 [Q1] (price effect +$242.4K [Q1]). The single largest driver was Customer#000000764 [Q8], which fell $977.6K [Q8] (32% [Q8] of total change, z=-3.9 [Q8]). Company-wide revenue fell only -3.5% [Q2] (-$11.16M [Q2]), so Japan underperformed by ~12.6 percentage points. CRM shows routine complaints and renewals but no causal mechanism.

## What drove it
The most significant driver was Customer#000000764 [Q8] (-$977.6K [Q8], 32% [Q8], z=-3.9 [Q8]). At segment level, AUTOMOBILE fell -$2.29M [Q4] (74% [Q4], z=-2.0 [Q4]) and HOUSEHOLD fell -$1.60M [Q4] (52% [Q4], z=-2.5 [Q4]), while BUILDING (+$1.00M [Q4], -32% [Q4], z=3.2 [Q4]) and FURNITURE (+$844.8K [Q4], -27% [Q4], z=2.7 [Q4]) partially offset. By order priority, 2-HIGH fell -$2.12M [Q5] (69% [Q5], z=-2.7 [Q5]).

## Why: what the CRM says
CRM [Q7] recorded 11 events [Q7] around the period: 8 complaints [Q7] (late delivery or invoice disputes) from 1995-04-02 through 1995-08-24, and 2 renewals [Q7] on unchanged terms (1995-12-23, 1996-02-09).
